metadata.description: The harness kit — sets up and keeps lean the Claude Code harness of new and existing projects, large ones included. Opinion: under a capable model, the least harness that works wins.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Sets up and keeps lean the Claude Code harness of a project — root CLAUDE.md, settings.json, per-component CLAUDE.md and the project knowledge layer — for new and existing projects, including large multi-component, long-lived codebases. One setup skill with three templates, and the flow's user-invoked commands; no agents or hooks.
